EC2: - Current use of blood thinners, [OR] lovastatin, [OR] ketoconazole, [OR] itraconazole, [OR] fexofenadine [OR] and triazolam.
EC3: - Other [NOT] non-pseudoachondroplasia related health conditions, e.g. cancers.
EC4: - Pregnancy [OR] or breastfeeding. Women must use adequate contraception during the study.
EC5: - Participation in another clinical study [OR] and/or using investigational agents.
EC6: - Use of Non-steroid anti-inflammatory (NSAIDs) [OR] or aspirin.
EC7: - Current use of Alfentanil, [OR] Cyclosporine, [OR] Dihydroergotamine, [OR] Dofetilide, [OR] Ergotamine, [OR] Fentanyl, [OR] Flibanserin, [OR] Oxycodone, [OR] Pimavanserin, [OR] Pimozide, [OR] Quinidine, [OR] Saquinavir, [OR] Sirolimus, [OR] Tacrolimus, [OR] Temsirolimus, [OR] Theophylline, [OR] Tizanidine, [OR] Thioridazine, [OR] Fosphenytoin, [OR] Phenytoin [OR] or Warfarin.
EC8: - Baseline level of pain of 2 or higher on 10 point scale.
EC9: - Platelet count below 50,000 per ul on baseline complete blood count (CBC).
